purpose: Keep submission cadence and displayed processed-image frequency independent of asynchronous capture and worker delivery delays.

contract.cadence: Use current monotonic time at admission, timestamp capture immediately before bitmap creation, and anchor the 125ms gate after a successful transfer. A delayed capture cannot spend the next submission interval.
contract.frequency: Compute frequency from increasing capture timestamps echoed by completed Rust reports over at most two seconds and 17 retained samples. Initial, reset or post-gap single samples display no rate. Result delivery jitter must not appear as increased capture throughput.
contract.verification: Reproduce delayed-capture submission bunching and delayed-result rate inflation on the parent with real WASM and synthetic sample input. Unit-test time admission, rolling rate and reset; retain all existing actual model, geometry, preset, lifecycle and CSP controls. No physical camera clock, speed, pose or hardware qualification.
contract.preservation: Preserve scientific JSON, frozen native binaries, prior camera outputs, resolved Cargo.lock and release WASM. No Rust/native/core/GPU changes, compiler runs, sensor acquisition or new SDK/model acquisition.

resources.strategy: Hard-link existing hash-identical vendor files into a fresh E: site. Reuse the release WASM, matching bindgen and installed browser/runtime; keep all evidence and failures.
resources.asset_download_scope: Zero covers local SDK/model acquisition. After publication bounded HTTPS checks may stream up to 32MiB without persisting vendor payloads.

remaining_80_percent: Measured canonical calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated acceptance remain open.
